Class MethaneClathrateStabilityEngine

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.engine.AbstractSimulationEngine
org.ether.society.engines.tier1.MethaneClathrateStabilityEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
SimulationEngineModule
public class MethaneClathrateStabilityEngine extends AbstractSimulationEngine
Marine Methane Clathrate Thermodynamic Stability & Dissociation Engine.

Formalizes the thermodynamic phase equilibrium of subsea methane hydrate reservoirs and benthic thermal outgassing established by Dickens et al. (1995), Buffett & Archer (2004), Sloan (1998), and Archer et al. (2009, PNAS).

Key Geophysical & Thermodynamic Mechanics:

  1. Phase Boundary Equilibrium Curve (Sloan 1998; Buffett & Archer 2004): \[ T_{\text{eq}}(P) = T_{\text{base}} + \alpha_{\text{hydrate}} \cdot \ln\left(\frac{P}{P_0}\right) - \Delta T_{\text{salinity}} \quad [^\circ\text{C}] \] where hydrostatic pressure at water depth \(z\) is \(P(z) = \rho_{\text{sw}} \cdot g \cdot z\) (in \(\text{MPa}\)), with reference pressure \(P_0 = 2.5\text{ MPa}\) (depth \(\approx 250\text{ m}\)), slope \(\alpha_{\text{hydrate}} \approx 9.5^\circ\text{C}\), and seawater salinity depression \(\Delta T_{\text{salinity}} \approx 1.2^\circ\text{C}\).
  2. Gas Hydrate Stability Zone (GHSZ) Thickness: With sediment geothermal gradient \(G_T \approx 0.035^\circ\text{C/m}\) (\(35^\circ\text{C/km}\)), the thickness of the sub-seafloor sediment stability layer is: \[ Z_{\text{GHSZ}}(z) = \max\left(0, \; \frac{T_{\text{eq}}(z) - T_{\text{bottom}}}{G_T}\right) \quad [\text{m}] \]
  3. Hyperthermal Clathrate Dissociation & Methane Outgassing: When deep ocean bottom water temperature \(T_{\text{bottom}}\) exceeds pre-industrial / glacial steady-state baselines (\(\Delta T_{\text{bottom}} > 0\)), thermal diffusion into benthic sediments causes thinning of the GHSZ (\(\Delta Z invalid input: '<' 0\)) and irreversible dissociation of frozen solid hydrates into gaseous methane (\(\text{CH}_4\)): \[ \Phi_{\text{CH}_4} = \kappa_{\text{dissoc}} \cdot A_{\text{benthic}} \cdot \max(0, T_{\text{bottom}} - T_{\text{bottom,baseline}}) \cdot \Delta t \quad [\text{Gt C / yr}] \]

      public static double calculateGHSZThicknessMeters(double depthMeters, double bottomWaterTempC)
      Calculates the thickness of the Gas Hydrate Stability Zone (GHSZ) in sub-seafloor sediment in meters: \[ Z_{\text{GHSZ}} = \max\left(0, \; \frac{T_{\text{eq}}(P(z)) - T_{\text{bottom}}}{G_T}\right) \]

    • estimateBottomWaterTemperature

      public static double estimateBottomWaterTemperature(double surfaceTempC, double depthMeters, double globalOceanWarmingAnomalyC)
      Estimates benthic ocean bottom water temperature from surface temperature and polar AMOC coupling. In deep oceans (\(z > 1000\text{ m}\)), water is buffered by polar sinking water (\(\approx 0.5 - 3.0^\circ\text{C}\)), warming when global ocean heat content increases.
      Parameters:
      surfaceTempC - surface temperature of cell in \(^\circ\text{C}\)
      depthMeters - water depth in meters
      globalOceanWarmingAnomalyC - deep ocean benthic warming anomaly from baseline
      Returns:
      estimated bottom water temperature in \(^\circ\text{C}\)
